role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 杀人于千里之外是狙击手的绝技。固定的火力弹幕让敌人应接不暇，接着抓住时机，使出一记杀手枪将他们带走。
hero_summary_en: Death from a distance is Sniper's specialty. He keeps his enemies on their toes with a steady barrage of firepower, and then, when the time is right, picks them off with a kill shot.

abilities.name: sniper_shrapnel
abilities.description_zh: 消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过%abilitychargerestoretime%秒恢复1点。
abilities.description_en: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
notes_zh: 总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。
notes_en: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
facet_text_en: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
facet_text_zh: 榴霰弹的减速和伤害提升，但是持续时间减少。

abilities.name: sniper_headshot
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手提高他的精确度，有一定概率造成%damage%点额外伤害并击退敌人。敌人距离狙击手越近，击退距离越远。爆头会短暂地降低敌人%slow%%%移动和攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.

abilities.name: sniper_take_aim
abilities.description_zh:
被动提升狙击手%passive_attack_range_bonus%攻击距离。

主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速%slow%%%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。
abilities.description_en:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

abilities.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
abilities.description_zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。
abilities.description_en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
shard_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

abilities.name: sniper_keen_scope
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手和目标相距每%bonus_damage_distance%距离，他的攻击都会造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

abilities.name: sniper_assassinate
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
abilities.description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。
notes_en: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。
